title: epan: Widen loop vars in packet-[p-z]*
description:
Fix

```
/builds/wireshark/wireshark/epan/dissectors/packet-pcomtcp.c:375:29: warning: loop variable has narrower type 'uint8_t' than iteration's upper bound 'uint16_t' [bugprone-too-small-loop-variable]
  375 |                 for (i = 0; i < nvalues; i++) {
      |                             ^
```

and similar warnings.
